hookScope: Set a hook on a scope the product owns, not on :root, so a runtime change restyles that scope only. To change one size only, set the hook on [data-size] within the scope, for example .promo [data-size="small"] { --scnx-segmented-control-item-color-hover: …; }; without it, the hook applies to every size in the scope.
